title: Lady Tory
summary_html: Lady Tory is a druid in possession of empathic powers who serves as Serpent's Hold's counselor in Ultima VII, and numbers among the trapped revelers imprisoned within Castle Britannia by the Guardian in Ultima Underworld II. In Ultima VII she has a baby although she had been separated from him, when he was kidnapped by harpies. Only with the Avatar’s help could they be reunited.
